The 2D drawing depicts **(Xantphos)Pd(Ph)(I)** — a square-planar Pd(II) oxidative-addition complex in which:

3. Screened conformations and used greedy phenyl-torsion optimization to eliminate all steric clashes in the metal pocket
4. Final GFN2-xTB constrained optimization (holding the four metal–ligand distances and key coordination angles) to physically relax the whole complex
